questions.qtext: Which one of the following statements is not correct for MOSFET?

options.text: MOSFET are easy to parallel for higher current.
Overload and peak current handling capability are high.

questions.solution:
(c)
• MOSFET has positive temperature coefficient for resistance. This makes parallel operation of MOSFETs easy.
• MOSFET is a unipolar impedance.
• It has high input impedance.
• It has lower switching losses but its on resistance and conduction losses are high.
